premise: While Maya sends the buggy zooming about to collect a heap of ordinary pebbles, the slow rover drills one hole all day — and finds the one rock with crystals in it.
inspiration: Aesop's 'The Tortoise and the Hare', turned into a treasure hunt where the hare shares the prize.
lesson: Slow and careful can find what fast and busy misses.

en-US.title: Slow and Steady
en-US.text: {woman:enter} Maya wanted the best rock on the Moon, and she wanted it fast. {woman:face happy} [excited] She sent the {buggy:enter} buggy zooming off across the plain to fetch them. {canvas:dust 0.5 6s} {buggy:live} Its wheels spun, and dust flew up behind it in long, lazy arcs. {sfx:zip} Zip! A pebble. Zoom! Another. {buggy:hop} By lunchtime its seats were piled high. Grey. Grey. Grey, grey, grey. Meanwhile, the slow {rover:enter} rover {rover:go to crater} had trundled down into the crater, to just one spot. {rover:live hold} And there it drilled. All morning. All afternoon. {rover:shake 0.3} {woman:face sad} [sighs] Maya sorted through her heap. Not one pebble was special. [short pause] {rover:live resume} Then the rover lifted its drill, and there in the dust lay a round {moon-rock:enter} moon rock. {moon-rock:live} It rocked gently, and crystals twinkled all over it. {sfx:twinkle} {woman:face surprised} [gasps] Maya loped {woman:go to crater} over to the crater's edge. {woman:face happy} [warmly] Then she picked her very best grey pebble and set it down by the rover's wheel. {rover:sparkle} A prize, for patience.

es-ES.title: Despacio y sin parar
es-ES.text: {woman:enter} Maya quería la mejor roca de la Luna, y la quería ya. {woman:face happy} [excited] Mandó al {buggy:enter} buggy a toda velocidad por la llanura a buscar piedras. {canvas:dust 0.5 6s} {buggy:live} Sus ruedas giraron, y el polvo salió volando detrás en largas curvas perezosas. {sfx:zip} ¡Zas! Una piedrecita. ¡Zum! Otra. {buggy:hop} A mediodía tenía los asientos a rebosar. Gris. Gris. Gris, gris, gris. Mientras tanto, el lento {rover:enter} róver {rover:go to crater} había bajado al cráter, a un solo sitio. {rover:live hold} Y allí taladraba. Toda la mañana. Toda la tarde. {rover:shake 0.3} {woman:face sad} [sighs] Maya revisó su montón. Ni una piedrecita era especial. [short pause] {rover:live resume} Entonces el róver levantó el taladro, y allí, en el polvo, apareció una {moon-rock:enter} roca lunar redonda. {moon-rock:live} Se balanceó suavemente, y unos cristalitos brillaron por todas partes. {sfx:twinkle} {woman:face surprised} [gasps] Maya fue dando saltos {woman:go to crater} hasta el borde del cráter. {woman:face happy} [warmly] Luego escogió su mejor piedrecita gris y la dejó junto a la rueda del róver. {rover:sparkle} Un premio, por la paciencia.

zip.prompt: a quick playful zip sound of a small vehicle darting past, comic and light
